plan.purpose: Independently frozen recheck of R105 direct-event CPU regressions; same-window serial ABBA/BAAB segments, no concurrent request streams.
plan.segment_order: a b b a b a a b
plan.production: Stock C; guarded disposable namespace per window, no installation; all before/after health, boot, config, mounts and identity checks and cleanup must pass.
plan.analysis: Aggregate four equal-size segments per side/lane before taking one ratio per window. Exact order-statistic median intervals, 12 comparisons Bonferroni family >=95% coverage; no pooling initial screen. Independent identically distributed block ratio assumptions remain explicit.
plan.decision: No performance retention before results. A subject CPU median >1% with interval wholly above 1 confirms material regression and rejects this variant; intervals crossing 1 are unresolved, not equality. Report every adverse metric. This recheck is not whole-daemon acceptance.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on any collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure and retain failed window. First window also validates new paired tool; if tool changes discard series and freeze new identities/order before restart.

limits: One independent observation per window; four segments per side are aggregated. Rank intervals assume independent identically distributed block ratios. Scope is only these direct-user-event workloads.
